Our story

Boom was founded by operators and technologists who lived the daily friction of running vacation rental businesses firsthand.

The industry was relying on stitched-together tools, manual workflows, and reactive decision-making — all while expectations from guests and owners kept rising. The problem wasn’t effort. It was infrastructure.

Boom was built to change that.

“Create a modern, intelligent platform that actually works the way vacation rental teams do — and evolves with them.”

From day one, the vision was clear. Today, Boom powers forward-thinking property managers who want clarity instead of complexity, automation instead of burnout, and insight instead of guesswork.

A truly global team

Boom is proudly remote-first and globally distributed. Our team spans multiple continents and countries, bringing together diverse perspectives, backgrounds, and lived experiences. We believe better products are built when different viewpoints are at the table — and when talent isn’t limited by geography.

What connects us isn’t location. It’s shared standards, shared ownership, and shared ambition.

Our core values

✦

Ownership over permission

If you see a problem, you help solve it. We value people who take initiative and follow through.

✦

Clarity beats complexity

In our product, our communication, and our decisions — simple scales, messy doesn’t.

✦

Build for the long term

We’re not chasing trends or shortcuts. We’re building durable technology and durable careers.

✦

Progress over perfection

Momentum matters. We ship, learn, refine, and move forward.

✦

Respect the human behind the role

Our platform supports people — and so do we. Burnout is not a badge of honor here.

Why work at Boom?

→You’ll help define a category — not just maintain a product

Let’s be direct: Boom isn’t for everyone. But if you want meaningful responsibility, room to lead, and the chance to build something that truly matters — this is worth your time.
